structured.answer: The page says to hold the money at פסגות and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500", ending with about 86,492 ₪ on 70,000 ₪ put in (at an assumed 7% and if the dollar stays put). But I would not act on it alone: I'd ask my son or the bank first, because I don't know פסגות and the screens were full of red minuses and English.

stuck.where: screen 1, the four boxes with sliders

labels too small, colours too close to tell apart

findings.what: Dark background with small coloured text is hard to read even enlarged
Many red minus numbers frighten and are not explained in plain words
Return of 7% preset with no word on risk; result looks like a promise
English letters and fund jargon with no Hebrew explanation
Cost bar labels too small and colours too similar
Too many numbers and tags per row; busy and tiring
Grey small text under bank names unreadable
No explanation of who פסגות is, though it is the recommended choice
